newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Pioneer Cement up 10.43 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Pioneer Cement up 10.43 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's Pioneer Cement gained 0.85 rupees, or 10.43 percent, to 9.0 rupees after the government scrapped a 12.5 percent sales tax on cement, but simultaneously raised excise duty to 40 percent from 35 percent.
"The decision will increase profits of the entire cement sector," dealer Ather Raouf said.

A turnover of 6,000 shares in the scrip was recorded during a special budget session of the Karachi Stock Exchange held to coincide with Finance Minister Sartaj Aziz's presentation of the budget for fiscal 1997/98 (July-June).
